about: A reporter's interview with a candidate (BOARD, Oct 12: the words for campaign interviews; GOV builds the interview). Every question copies GOV's records of the race: the outlet, the office, each issue and what it would change, and the candidate's own recorded stance where there is one. The candidate's answers name only those records.

greet.text: Thanks for making time. {{outlet}} is talking to everyone running for {{office}}.

terms.text: This is all on the record.
We agreed this is on background.
Nothing today goes in the paper under your name.

askRecord.text: You've said you want to {{change}}. Why?

redirect.text: The bigger question in this race is {{other-issue}}.

decline.text: I'll have more to say on that later.

close.text: That's all I have. Thanks for your time.
